recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, centered typographic composition featuring bold, geometric sans-serif lettering on a flat, light-gray neutral background, emphasizing extreme negative space and balanced horizontal alignment.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-to-background ratio favoring vast negative space
Horizontal symmetry across the central axis
High contrast between black glyphs and light-gray field
coreInvariants: Dead-center placement of the text block
Uniform stroke weight in the typeface

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Text is positioned exactly in the center of the frame, occupying approximately 15-20% of the total width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central mathematical symbol or connector between the two primary words.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Static; the eye is drawn immediately to the center and remains there due to the lack of peripheral detail.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant; the light-gray field acts as a structural element that compresses the text into a focal point.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for all typographic elements
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the dark text and light background.

letterConstructionRules: Circular curves in letters like D and S
Sharp, precise vertices in letters like A and N
graphicDevices: Mathematical plus symbol as a central connector

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the circular geometry and modern, clean aesthetic.
Open-source alternative with similar geometric proportions.
Classic geometric sans with sharp vertices.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid, flat, light-gray background with a hex code near #D1D5D6. Ensure no gradients, textures, or noise.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place two words in all-caps bold geometric sans-serif, separated by a plus sign, exactly in the center of the frame. Use wide tracking and solid black fill.

verificationChecks: Is the text perfectly centered horizontally and vertically?
Is the background a single flat color without artifacts?
Is the tracking wide enough to feel airy but cohesive?

adjustableVariables: Scale of the text block relative to the canvas
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or trademarked logos
The specific kerning of the original source
postGenerationChecks: Check for any stray pixels or noise in the gray field.
Ensure the plus sign is vertically aligned with the cap height of the letters.
Verify the black is a true neutral black (#000000).
Confirm the composition feels 'empty' except for the central focal point.
recipe.reuseFormula: Flat Neutral Background + Centered Bold Geometric Sans-Serif + Wide Tracking + High Contrast
